name: Men-Tal
source:
"Men-tal"

Who are you?

You can decide that by how you interact
with the residents of the town you reside in.

Will you let you bad side go ham?
or
Will you be the kind, well respected resident?
or maybe 
You can strike the perfect balance between the two.

[from [url=https://glitchervius.itch.io/men-tal]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“Men-tal”

你是谁？

你与所居城镇居民的互动方式，
将决定这个答案。

你会放任恶劣的一面肆意妄为？
还是
成为善良、受人尊敬的居民？
又或者，
在两者之间找到完美的平衡。

[摘自[url=https://glitchervius.itch.io/men-tal]itch.io[/url]]
